requiredFindings.title: Describe the existing HOME exceptions accurately
requiredFindings.finding: The proposed law authorizes the real HOME only for comparison against a fixture home, and the plan repeats that condition. Three enumerated calls do something else: installation_routing_tests.rs:1024-1025, ordinary_writer_tests.rs:116-117 and read_premise_tests.rs:104-105 construct HOME/Library/Application Support/OpenSIP and call exists() to assert installation absence. Only installation_root.rs:787 compares the account-derived home against the environment value. All current call sites are represented by the listed files, but the proposed purpose restriction does not cover three of those actual uses. Consequently the list is not exact against the pinned product in the sense requested, and round-1 RF-02 is not fully resolved.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Revise the proposed item-9 bullet and plan to distinguish the single comparison from the three test-only installation-absence probes, naming their concrete enclosing test items and limiting each exception to its actual use. Alternatively explicitly plan to remove those probes and pin the reduced post-change exception set. Do not describe the existing probes as fixture comparisons. Correct the associated change-table description.

requiredFindings.title: Keep marker custody and refusal-only Git behavior in the controls
requiredFindings.finding: Two controls rely on false claims about existing checks. The carriers row says a .opensip and local.json appearing in CI never refuse because nothing observed them. Section 1.1 correctly retains the marker lookup: observe_marker still opens and judges .opensip and observes project-id.v1 in every mode, and ProjectRootAdmission::recheck repeats that observation. An appearing wrong-custody directory or a changed marker can therefore refuse independently of local.json. Separately the hostile-environment control says a Git-free fixture prevents X2 refusal. observe_tracking checks the environment before repository discovery; hostile HOME or XDG_CONFIG_HOME refuses even when no repository exists. Carrier capture and pure resolution can be tested without that tracking step, but the plan must say so rather than promise an impossible Git-check outcome.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Narrow the CI appearance control to a custody-valid .opensip with no project-id.v1, proving no local-carrier lookup or refusal attributable to local.json while retaining ordinary marker/custody refusals. Add or retain a contrasting marker/custody refusal assertion. State that the carrier/resolver environment-equivalence control stops before tracking, or separately assert the permitted Git environment refusal; remove the claim that repository absence disables that check.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The change table says fifteen test-only environment variables. The pinned source contains 17 disallowed-method call sites: one production vars_os call and 16 test-only calls, covering 13 distinct test variable names (HOME occurs four times). Use those counts, or omit the count. The proposed B1-b child marker is additional and does not yet exist.
